Python and C++ are labeled required because proficiency in one is explicitly assessed; this is an alternative, not a requirement for both. Flagged because the posting also says there is no hard language requirement.

Mapped programming fundamentals to software engineering; did not infer software architecture from design principles or CI/CD from software deployment.
Excluded technologies appearing only in project examples or responsibilities, including distributed systems and monitoring.
Quant research is domain knowledge; internal-user support and management experience are not treated as named technical skills.
Previous experience and rapid advancement do not supply a seniority signal under the guide. The Campus/New Grad reference redirects other applicants and does not describe this role's level.
